statement: Akamai reported Cloud Infrastructure Services revenue of $99 million in Q2 2026, up 39% year-over-year, including GPU cloud services.
why: A non-hyperscaler growing GPU-inclusive cloud revenue near 40% shows demand for rented accelerator capacity is spreading beyond the big three clouds.

impact.mechanism: Growing revenue at a second-tier GPU cloud provider implies continued accelerator purchases to serve customer workloads.

evidence.source: Akamai Technologies (official press release via GlobeNewswire)
evidence.excerpt: Cloud Infrastructure Services revenue reached $99 million in Q2 2026, representing 39% year-over-year growth.

confidence.basis: Company earnings release distributed via a newswire and captured at secondary tier; single fetched document, so confidence capped at medium.
